conventions.convention: Objects are nonnegative integers, including zero; inputs are on top and outputs below. Each connected class removed entirely from the middle contributes one factor δ.
Rational group invariants satisfy the coordinate-ring coaction equation λ(f)=1⊗f. For the displayed left coaction on vectors, the left action is recovered by evaluating at g inverse.

The Gram and classical invariant-theory branches use algebraically closed characteristic-zero fields and the full orthogonal or symplectic group. They do not assert the corresponding special-orthogonal result.
The invariant-theory normality, descent, and downstream FFT/SFT results explicitly assume AC, including the assumptions inherited from their commutative-algebra suppliers.
In the symplectic Brauer action, crossings act by minus the flip, caps by the alternating form, and cups by its inverse tensor; the loop parameter is minus dim V.
Multilinear contractions orient every pair i<j and use B(v_i,v_j), fixing Pfaffian signs. Orthogonal independence holds exactly for r≤m; symplectic independence exactly for r≤n when dim V=2n.
Partition refinement is ordered toward coarsenings; x_d is obtained by integer Möbius inversion. N≥1 is both a cardinality and its scalar image in the field; the theorem permits every characteristic.

BMW uses z=q−q inverse, g_i−g_i inverse=z(1−e_i), g_i e_i=ρ inverse e_i, and z(δ−1)=ρ−ρ inverse. The definition does not require z or δ invertible; the universal tangle-basis theorem separately inverts δ.

load_bearing.statement: Assuming AC, over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, the symmetric (m+1)-minor ideal and alternating principal (m+2)-Pfaffian ideal are prime, define precisely the respective rank-at-most-m loci, and have normal quotient rings, in the stated ranges.

Assuming AC and the stated characteristic-zero form hypotheses, for t≥m+1 the spanning-tuple Gram map over the rank-m locus is an étale principal bundle; invariant regular functions descend and extend uniquely across the lower-rank locus.

Assuming AC over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, full orthogonal and symplectic polynomial invariants are generated by Gram contractions, with kernels respectively the (m+1)-minor and principal (2n+2)-Pfaffian ideals.

Under its stated AC and classical-group hypotheses, matching contractions span the even multilinear invariants, odd multilinear invariants vanish, and all relations are the specified determinant or Pfaffian products. Independence holds exactly for r≤m orthogonally and r≤n symplectically.
Identity strands, crossing, cap, and cup generate the R-linear Brauer category, and the displayed relations together with their duals are complete over every commutative unital ring.

The stated universal coefficient ring A is a domain, and closed diagrams admit the unique regular-isotopy-invariant evaluation with the specified skein, curl, circle, and empty-diagram rules. The empty diagram freely generates the closed-diagram quotient.
For every field, N≥1 and r≥0, the partition action has image End over S_N of W tensor r; its kernel is spanned by orbit-basis elements with more than N blocks, and it is injective exactly when N≥2r.
